name: Anoka Farmers' Market
tagline: Ask a Master Gardener: Farmers Market on the Rum — Anoka County Master Gardeners
description: Anoka Farmers' Market gathers local farms and food producers in 2315 2nd Ave, MN. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
